releases.body:
Give our header figures one order and a hint that keeps them

Three plugins draw in the same row, and their order lived in a shared number that a reload re-shuffles: one number each now, in a band. When the header runs short only the glyph stays, so the hint carries the figure — and all three say it the same way.

Release oc-coffee 0.2.5, oc-budget 0.1.7.


Record: docs/oc-tps-meter.md

Record why a publish needs a terminal

A publish from a shell with no terminal exits at once and leaves behind an authentication URL that dies with the process, so the page answers "route not found" to whoever clicks it. The trap cost two attempts on the first publication of oc-tps-meter.
